title: Bronze Mall
content: Has anyone dreamt of this mall? I saw it as bronze and very luxurious. Also, if it helps, I never feel scared here, it just feels like I want to shop, but I stay in the atrium/common area, I never go into any stores unfortunately lol. *this was the best I could get ChatGPT to create this image. In my dream, I see the stores all around me and there are different levels. I’m on the lowest level. I see the luxury stores and the elevators all in bronze.
